description: Search KeebFinder mechanical keyboards, switches or keycaps by text and specs. Prices are USD and refreshed daily across 40+ stores. Returns compact summaries without full specs or store-by-store offers. When a product is out of stock, lowestPriceUsd is the last known price. keebfinderScore is the KeebFinder rating and includes a brand and vendor adjustment, so it is an editorial score, not a neutral measurement.

features.description: Features the product must have, all of them. Keyboards: Hot-Swappable, QMK Support, VIA Support, VIAL Support, Hall Effect, Rapid Trigger, Knob Support, Low Profile, Pre-Built, Diy Kit/Barebones, Sound Dampening, Screw-In Stabilizers, USB-C, Mac/Win Support. Switches: Factory Lubed, Long Pole, Silent, Double Stage, Magnetic Hall Effect, Dust Proof, Low Profile, Water Resistant. Keycaps: Sculpted Profile, Includes Numpad, Includes ISO Enter, Supports 40s, Supports Ortho, Supports Alice, Supports HHKB.

inStock.description: Defaults to true, which returns only products in stock. Set false to include out-of-stock products.

layoutSize.description: Keyboards only. Percentage such as "60%", "65%", "75%", "80%", "100%", or "Numpad" or "Macropad".

layoutStandard.description: Keyboards and keycaps. "ANSI", "ISO" (any ISO variant), a regional ISO such as "ISO-DE", "ISO-UK", "ISO-FR", "ISO-ES", "ISO-Nordic", or "JIS".

material.description: Keycaps only. Material such as "PBT" or "ABS".

maxActuationForceGf.description: Switches only. Maximum actuation force in grams-force.

minActuationForceGf.description: Switches only. Minimum actuation force in grams-force.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Use nextOffset from the previous page.

query.description: Words that must appear in the product name or brand, e.g. "keychron q1".

sort.description: Default is popularity, which is KeebFinder's own popularity ranking. It can include commercial weighting, see https://keeb-finder.com/terms-of-service#ranking.

store.description: Only products sold by this store, e.g. "Epomaker".

switchType.description: Keyboards only. Switch type the keyboard is sold with.

name: search_products
title: Search products
